# Code-mix word bank usage review

**Status: fully reviewed.** This snapshot reflects the word bank AFTER 3 rounds of human review (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-14, 992 corrections applied — 910 corrected, 82 removed — see data/lexicon/codemix_review_corrections.jsonl and LOG.md for the full record). Entries below are impact-ordered against the corrected bank, so this is an audit trail of what shipped, not a fresh TODO list.

2969 word bank entries actually fired during generation (out of 4118 in the bank), impact-ordered — the top entries here cover the large majority of all substitutions in the corpus. Machine-translated entries (source=llm) and anything flagged codemix_plausible=False are where the review risk concentrates; verify those first.
